episode_title: Colom Wins Mississippi, Trump Warns Incoming Democrats, Russia-Ukraine Talks
script_en: Colom Wins Mississippi, Trump Warns Incoming Democrats, Russia-Ukraine Talks.

Democrat Scott Colom won Mississippi’s Senate race by fewer than 5,000 votes, becoming the state’s first Black senator since Reconstruction and ending a more than 40-year stretch without a Democrat in the seat.

The White House is warning Democrats that their planned investigations could cross into “blatant criminality,” previewing a legal and political fight over congressional oversight when Democrats take control next year.

Russia and Ukraine agreed to a major prisoner exchange after two days of U.S.-mediated talks, as American envoys meet Vladimir Putin and Volodymyr Zelenskyy to explore whether a broader European security agreement could help end the war.
